861:t_114:9.en:
$$ラルク$$

861:t_114:10.en:
$$ラルク$$

kept_omissions: 861:t_111:6: 'You get some rest, too...' - the person addressed is not stated (the player or a sleeping comrade); kept as plain 'you'.
861:t_112:6: last sentence 'At least today, the day that leads into tomorrow...' kept trailing off as in the Japanese.
861:t_121:3: Nono's unit-loss line has no stated subject; 'I got shot down' read as Nono/her unit.
uncertain: アホウドリ rendered 'Dumbatross' (near-miss pun) in 861:t_114:9 and 861:t_121:7 to match dlg_2700_10 (Tycho 861:t_122:7); 121:3-8 reuse dlg_2700_10 wording for the identical Japanese.
861:t_118:5 parody title 'Big Sis! Nono Is a Flightless Ostrich!' (お姉さま！ノノは飛べないダチョウです！) is Nono's/Tycho's gag, not a real stage title.

Nono's catchphrase 努力と根性 = 'hard work and guts' (119/120), while the quoted Spirit Command names 『努力』『根性』『閃き』『不屈』 (121:5, 121:7) use the Jigoku UI names Gain/Vigor/Alert/Persist; the catchphrase/command link is weaker in English.
861:t_111:3-5: Chirico's growing silence (4/6/8 ellipses) kept as growing dot rows (12/18/24); a mechanical pass may normalise to 9 dots.
861:t_116/117:8: ヨ・ロ・シ・ク rendered 'Count-ing-on-you!' (Nicola asks Lal'C).
